failures.observed: The first 1000-line activation-baton projection exceeded the bounded display and was internally truncated.
failures.recovery: Restarted the read using contiguous bounded windows and later verified every line through the exact EOF marker.
failures.recovery_observed: All 4,645 lines were read in order through the exact EOF sentence with no gap.

failures.observed: A later 400-line activation-baton projection also exceeded the bounded display and was internally truncated.
failures.recovery: Reduced the immutable read window to 250 lines and retained ordered start/end offsets.
failures.recovery_observed: The 250-line sequence covered the complete baton without overlap-dependent omissions.

failures.observed: The first compact canonical-receipt projection guessed absent manifest/session keys and displayed null-derived mismatch counts.
failures.recovery: Inspected exact top-level and aggregate keys before making a corrected scalar projection.
failures.recovery_observed: The exact receipt status, one-shot counters, checks and manifest arrays were recovered without replay.

failures.observed: The first failure-ledger compact projection guessed id and original_success_credit rather than witness_id and original_subject_success_credit.
failures.recovery: Inspected the actual witness record shape, then projected only the observed exact keys.
failures.recovery_observed: All 230 source failures were unique, false, same-owner, non-independent and zero-credit.

failures.observed: The first collision-and-capacity PowerShell probe embedded native status inside an assignment and failed parser validation before useful evidence was collected.
failures.recovery: Separated each native command from scalar construction and captured exit state only after the command returned.
failures.recovery_observed: The Caelen branch, remote ref and worktree path were shown absent before lane creation.

failures.observed: The corrected split collision probe called Trim on an empty remote-ref result and raised a read-only null-method error.
failures.recovery: Treated empty remote output as an empty string before normalization and reran only the bounded read-only check.
failures.recovery_observed: No remote Caelen main ref existed; no repository or remote state changed.

failures.observed: The first combined worktree-creation wrapper contained a parser fault in its final diagnostic expression, so no Git mutation ran.
failures.recovery: Split the registration, orphan switch, sparse setup and final diagnostics into directly checked commands.
failures.recovery_observed: One clean unborn Caelen orphan branch and D-first sparse worktree were created with the exact owner path only.

failures.observed: The first planning validator treated its own literal raw-route scanner definition as a payload candidate and stopped with 91 of 92 checks passing.
failures.recovery: Construct the scanner tokens from inert fragments while retaining the exact same payload classes, then rerun only the bounded planning validator.
failures.recovery_observed: The scanner definition no longer self-matched; the owner payload remained free of confirmed raw-route material.

failures.observed: The first staged-review helper climbed one directory beyond the Caelen worktree and Git rejected --cached in a no-index context before creating a receipt.
failures.recovery: Resolve the repository root exactly three parents above the owner root and verify it with rev-parse before reading the index.
failures.recovery_observed: The corrected helper addressed the Caelen worktree and read its staged owner allowlist.

failures.observed: The first receipt-staging command followed the failed helper and rejected the nonexistent staged-review receipt path.
failures.recovery: Require the helper exit code and receipt existence before staging the declared self-exclusion.
failures.recovery_observed: The corrected sequence staged the generated review receipt only after it existed and passed.

failures.observed: Because the PowerShell wrapper did not convert the first native nonzero exit into a terminating error, it repeated the same incorrect staged-review helper once.
failures.recovery: Run each native stage gate separately and stop immediately on a nonzero LASTEXITCODE.
failures.recovery_observed: The bounded recovery sequence stopped on each native failure and did not repeat a failed gate.

failures.observed: The continued wrapper attempted to stage the still-missing review receipt a second time and Git rejected the same absent literal path.
failures.recovery: Guard the exact receipt path with a literal existence check before the single stage operation.
failures.recovery_observed: The receipt existed, was staged once, and matched its working bytes.
